Name: Tola, Son of Puah
Summary: Tola, son of Puah, son of Dodo, a man of Issachar, judged Israel twenty-three years and dwelt in Shamir in Mount Ephraim. He is distinct from Tola, son of Issachar, in Genesis.
KeyStory: After Abimelech, Tola arose to defend Israel, judged twenty-three years from Shamir in Mount Ephraim, and died and was buried there.
LifeLesson: A quiet twenty-three years of defending Israel left barely a paragraph — and that is enough.
